title.narrative: Strengthening civil society and farmers for food systems transformation

description.narrative: FIAN will serve as a technical partner to the programme in Zambia, with a primary focus on strengthening local organisations in the realisation of the right to food. The partner will also contribute to key thematic areas, including climate change and sustainable agriculture, with a strong emphasis on supporting the transition toward resilient, equitable, and sustainable food systems. As part of this effort, FIAN will host a national agroecology cooperative aimed at reorganising the subsector and enhancing nationwide access to markets. Aligned with We Effect’s Local-to-Global Advocacy Strategy, FIAN will amplify the voices of local organisations to support evidence-based advocacy, drawing on data and experiences from women’s organisations. The partner will undertake annual right-to-food monitoring, document violations, and hold duty bearers accountable. This includes facilitating access to litigation for affected households and individuals, promoting agroecology policy reforms, and supporting participation in cooperatives as well as national and global food systems summits. Furthermore, FIAN will lead global advocacy initiatives on climate justice and food system transformation by creating a platform that elevates the perspectives and priorities of local women’s organisations, ensuring their experiences inform policy dialogue and international debates. As part of its climate justice agenda, FIAN will also advocate for debt cancellation for drought-affected countries and strengthened commitments on loss and damage compensation, ensuring vulnerable communities receive the support needed to rebuild and adapt.
